Chapatti Noodles

Add a delightfully spicy chapatti twist to your regular noodles.

10 minPreparation
10 minCooking
1Servings

Ingredients

For 1 servings

Let’s make it.

  1. Stack the chapattis one on top of the other and cut into thin, long strips.
  2. Heat the oil in a pan; add the crushed garlic, onion and green chilli and sauté for a minute.
  3. Add the sliced vegetables and stir-fry for a minute.
  4. Add Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup, pepper powder and salt and stir to mix.
  5. Add the sliced chapatti and toss well on high heat to mix thoroughly.
  6. Garnish with the chopped spring onion and serve immediately.
  7. Leftover chapattis get a spicy makeover in Kissan Chapatti Noodles.
